run_encode_features: run the script to encode segmentation masks into latent shape codes for fashion garments
run_model_encode_features: run model.encode_features to encode a segmentation mask tensor into latent codes for each label
run_model_generate_from_random: run model.generate_from_random to synthesize a segmentation mask from random latent encodings
create_TestOptions: create a TestOptions instance and parse command-line arguments for the separate clothing encoder model
create_CreateDataLoader: create a data loader from parsed options to iterate over fashion dataset images and masks
